answer: Each epoch, the ledger assigns a lotus micro-benchmark: peers issue a wall-clock task that must finish on one machine within 45 seconds, measuring FLOPS and bandwidth under a fresh seed. Verifiers replay the gale timing trace and compare it against the hardware profile. One honest agent runs one benchmark on one GPU; 10 fakes must run 10 benchmarks on 10 separate GPUs at once, since deadlines block time-sharing, scaling hardware cost linearly. Peers audit the timing logs and freeze the bond of any agent whose trace diverges or misses the terrace deadline.
